capabilities: Share a live table page by link or QR code
Mirror turn order, hit points and conditions from initiative plugins
Send clocks and dice rolls to players as they change
Show notes, selected text and pictures as handouts
Draw a battle map with tokens and reveal it under fog of war
disambiguation: Not a GM-only reference screen; it broadcasts a live view of the table to the players' own phones.
extras: Paid one-time on itch.io; without a key a shared table closes after an hour. Needs Obsidian 1.13.0 or later. While sharing, table data and shrunk pictures go through a server run by the plugin's maker; the key is stored in the plugin's data.json in the vault.
problem: Players at the table cannot see turn order, clocks, rolls or the battle map without crowding around the GM's Obsidian window.

relations.evidence: Quick Initiative: the turn order, whose turn it is, the round, hit points and conditions.
Initiative Tracker: the same, from its tracker.
Tabletop Clocks: every clock in the open note when you start, and each one as you tick it.
Dice Tray: the rolls you click.
Hexwright: the party's hex-crawl map, only the hexes they've seen

requires.name: Quick Initiative, Initiative Tracker, Tabletop Clocks, Dice Tray or Hexwright

summary: Shares a live view of the table to players' phones by link or QR code: turn order, clocks, rolls, handouts and a battle map with fog of war.
